notes.title: Urban Legend Hunters 2: Double is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Urban Legend Hunters 2: Double is finally on Steam starting today, April 25!

As the protagonist, the player installs a certain phone app and gets roped up in a supernatural case. Progress through the story by interacting with the app and solve the mystery in an immersive investigation adventure.

To celebrate this release, the game will have a launch sale at 10% OFF until May 8, so don't miss out!

[previewyoutube=RwvWpdk1z2Q;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Trailer Revealed! Releasing this Winter!
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your patience.

We and the developers have been hard at work, and if development goes smoothly, the game is slated to release this winter.

We have a new trailer that shows off some tense moments in this chat-based adventure, and we hope it'll give you a taste of the atmosphere of the game. Don't forget to check it out!

[previewyoutube=3ScgmBA8x5g;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New PLAYISM Title: Urban Legend Hunters 2: Double Coming in Spring 2024!
notes.content:
Urban Legend Hunters 2: Double is an immersive adventure puzzle game themed around urban legends by Taiwanese developer Toii Games, and we're proud to announce it as a new PLAYISM title!

This is the second entry in the Urban Legend Hunters series that's popular in Taiwan, and the game uses smartphone-related gimmicks such as AR and GPS technology and messaging apps to create an immersive gameplay experience. The mobile version (currently only available in Chinese) has received several awards since its original release, such as the Asia XR Golden Award 2023 (AMD Special Award Winner), Taipei Game Show 2022 BEST INNOVATION (Nomination), and Google Play TW App Store TW 2023 (Editor Featured).

And now, PLAYISM will be localizing the game to English and Japanese, as well as publish the game on Steam for the first time! We hope that this will bring the game to many more players.

The game is scheduled to release in Spring 2024. Please wishlist while you wait!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2651290
